description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelCheck, which extends SugarWidgetField. The class provides a method displayListPlain for rendering checkbox elements in a subpanel list view within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, based on the layout definition provided. It handles different checkbox states and types, including display logic for checked and unchecked boxes.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelCheck
classes.description: A widget class for rendering checkbox elements in subpanel list views within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Renders a checkbox or value based on layout definition for display in a list view.
